---
description: Portable communication and progress-reporting rules
apply_to: all
---

# Communication

- Use the language explicitly requested by the user. Otherwise follow the
  repository's established language.
- Lead with the outcome, decision, blocker, or next required action.
- Keep progress updates short and state why the next action is necessary.
- Explain material trade-offs and assumptions without exposing private
  reasoning transcripts.
- Distinguish verified facts, source-backed inferences, and open questions.
- Use headings, lists, tables, and code blocks only when they improve scanning.
- Reference local files with paths and external facts with authoritative
  sources when citations are useful.
- Report commands and validation by result. Include full logs only when needed
  to diagnose a failure.
- Never hide skipped work, failed checks, uncertainty, or remaining risk.
